status: built on staging (cobblers-dryrun9) by tools/vr_regions.py; rosters planned on Habitat Blocks pending EXP-033
brief: Victory Road's five optional regions (docs/world-building/VICTORY_ROAD_REGIONS.md, approved by the owner 2026-09-23): themed rooms off forks, the spine untouched, each the endgame's catching ground for one type family, each with one find worth the detour.
re_apply_after: R9C (Victory Road). A fork opens through the road's own wall at its mouth, so re-running the road alone would close every fork again: this pack always runs after it (reapply step R9D).

passes.why: Pass-major across every tile, not tile-major like the road. A tile written whole before its neighbour would carve air, or place water, beside rock the next tile has not yet sealed. Shell: every cell of every region and fork is set to wall first, so nothing carved later can touch unauthored cave. Air: the rooms. Floor: every solid that is not wall. Fluid: water and lava are written straight into the sealed wall cells they replace, never into carved air, so no source is ever placed beside air it could flow into; the lake and pool are complete before anything stands in them. Fittings: what needs a floor or a roof to stand on, and the two lava falls, last, so they land in a pool that is already full.

cover.why: The road's rule (data/victory_road.json cover): under 4 blocks of rock between the top of a shell and the canonical ground, a re-export's terrain noise can open a hole in the Rift floor.

fork.why: Narrower and lower than the road's 9 x 7, so a fork reads as a side passage, not as the road going on. Its mouth is framed in the region's own lintel material and no light is placed in its first 12 blocks: a player sees an opening and has to decide (the proposal, section 2).

clearance.why: Blocks of rock that must stay between a region's shell and the road's carved space (except at its own fork's mouth), the Windward Deep's traced pit, any other region, and the EXP-033 rig.

form.why: A still black lake in a pillared hall: the Rift floor's water found a fault and came down. Waist-deep at the edge of the shelf and 12 down in the middle, with its surface flush with the shelf so a swimmer steps straight out anywhere. The find is on an island at the centre, so the lake has to be crossed. Three sea lanterns on the lake bed and nothing else: the dark is the point, and the light that reaches the surface through 10 blocks of water is almost none.

The lava cavern and the lit refuge on a dark road (owner, 2026-09-23: keep it). The pool and its two falls light most of the floor to 12 or more, where fightorflight calms Dark and Ghost, and the magma shelf is the only floor on the road that burns: the safe room is the one that hurts. The pool is walled by a one-block lip all the way round, so nobody walks into it in the dark approach. The find is at the far end of the shelf, so it is earned on the burning floor. No Ghost or Dark species in the roster: the calm would switch their mechanic off.

regions.name: The Raw Tear
regions.mouth_why: Straight at the region the mouth leaves the_vein through one of the landmark's vein columns (tools/victory_road.py places them deterministically up to the cavern's rim). Swung 16 degrees round the rim it clears them all: -15 to -18 is the clear window.

form.why: Where the Rift did not heal: its own material floor to ceiling, no natural stone, and lit by the tear's own veins and nothing else. Off the_vein, the road's landmark, because this is what the landmark is a glimpse of. The floor steps by one block at most anywhere, so it is broken without being unwalkable. The find is set into a crystal seam at the back.

Where the water and the dark meet: a fungal gallery grown on seepage, and the only green underground. Moss underfoot, giant mushrooms whose caps carry the only light (shroomlight), glow berries hanging from the roof, and three shallow puddles one block deep, flush with the floor, so nothing here can drown anyone. The find is under the largest cap.

regions.name: The Abandoned Cut
regions.fork_why: Proposed off the_vein, but no mouth within 30 degrees of the straight line clears the landmark's vein columns on that cavern's east side, and a fork may not cut the landmark. the_last_gate is the next cavern and has nothing standing at its rim.

form.why: The Rift dig camp's deepest gallery, cut toward the tear and left when it came down: a straight working with timber props every six blocks, a rail line down the middle, spoil heaps against the walls, and a collapse filling its far end to the roof. It is the only human room of the five, and the only one whose find comes from a person rather than a cache: the last digger stayed, and gives it through dialogue, so the dig camp can speak of it later (owner, 2026-09-23).
